= table-comment-directives(1)
:doctype: manpage

:manname: table-comment-directives
:manpurpose: keep directives active in table buffers

== Name

table-comment-directives - keep directives active in table buffers

== Synopsis

T01 Plain table cell.

[cols="1"]
|===
|
////
include::table_comment_visible.inc[]
////
|===

T02 Literal table cell.

[cols="1l"]
|===
|
////
include::table_comment_visible.inc[]
////
|===

T03 AsciiDoc cell comment.

[cols="1a"]
|===
|
////
include::table_comment_visible.inc[]
footnote:[Hidden table note.] (((Hidden table term))) anchor:hidden-table[]
////

A03 Visible cell content.
|===

!

----

include::missing-table-comment-file.adoc[]

////
|===
include::another-missing-table-comment-file.adoc[]

[cols="1a"]
|===
|
include::table_comment_cell.asciidoc[]

A11 Visible after the included comment.
|===
